svg.title: AREA 42
svg.desc: Send three players through 1 and one through 2. On arrival, use only the left orange switch in the direction of travel; the other triggers traps. The group takes 3→3′; the solo player breaks the rocks beyond the orange gate. Regroup, collect supplies, then take 4→4′ and head north. Clear the two jar traps before the timed switch. The platform boxes are optional and trigger fire traps on entry. Destroy both jar traps before using the timed switch. Optional cage: shoot the boxes from outside. Warping in triggers turrets. After warps 1 and 2, use only the left switch ahead. The right one triggers traps.

g.title: Sakura: 釣鐘トラップ; PSO Palace: two Jar Traps (Area 42)
Sakura: optional warp boxes and turrets; PSO World: shoot boxes before entry (Area 42)
